author: Mark Atwood
text: Fixed in commit 750fed2ed7 (test(coap): rangetest suite assert hygiene). Dropped the vacuous zassert_equal(lichen_rangetest_seq(), 0U, "4.01 must not mutate") in test_post_requires_oscore_or_local_admin: the POST handler never mutates s_seq (only lichen_rangetest_update() does), so the assert could not fail even with the gate deleted. Added response_payload_len == 0 asserts to both 4.01 branches of test_get_interval_requires_authz (interval-body GET and observe+interval GET), matching the POST authz test. Evidence: twister qemu_x86/atom 1/1 configurations passed, 13/13 test cases passed, 0 failed/errored (outdir /Volumes/Attic/tmp/twister-observe/twister.json).
